notes: T6 negative case for the `0..a.len()` form: `a[i]` is safe only while `a` is not reassigned in the body. The reassignment form `mut a: &[i32]` + `a = b` is already refused by ownership (E-OWN-REF-ESCAPE: a reference cannot be stored in Core 1.0), and the trap is emitted too; the case fixes both codes. No valid Core 1.0 program can reassign a slice binding, so that clause of the rule is defensive (documented in RFC-RT-TRAPS-1 §6).
